subject: reasoning
question: Seven people G, H, I, K, L, M and S are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between I and S. M sits to the immediate left of S. No one sits to the right of H. Only two people sit between H and M. K sits to the immediate right of L. How many people sit between G and K?
solution:
Given :Seven people G, H, I, K, L, M and S are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only three people sit between I and S. M sits to the immediate left of S.
 
• No one sits to the right of H.
 
• Only two people sit between H and M.
 
• K sits to the immediate right of L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edebd6a81d12cadc0e50dfa6661e490c1f6f1bdaa71860b8b8dbae28947ffc96.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
